1: -module(quod_agent_failover_SUITE).
    2: -moduledoc """
    3: Four real QUIC validators retain quorum after host VM loss or suspension.
    4: Three surviving node actors observe that host; the ontology requires two reports
    5: and chooses between two eligible destinations. Replacement custody is generated
    6: by the ordinary recovery reaction, never installed by the test.
    7: The former host returns from retained custody, either rebooted or still running,
    8: without failback.
    9: """.
   10: -include_lib("common_test/include/ct.hrl").
   11: -include_lib("stdlib/include/assert.hrl").
   12: -include("quod_ledger.hrl").
   13: -export([all/0, init_per_testcase/2, end_per_testcase/2,
   14:          validator_host_loss_recovers_state/1,
   15:          abrupt_host_loss_recovers_state/1,
   16:          suspended_host_retires_stale_process/1,
   17:          uncertain_claim_recovers_after_quorum_loss/1,
   18:          uncertain_claim_recovers_after_target_restart/1]).
   19: -export([hold_claim_admission/3, begin_uncertain_claim/1,
   20:          release_claim_and_await_expiry/3]).
   21: -export([bind_node/2, submit_node/1, await_goal/3, await_agent/3, await_observer/2, await_process_down/2,
   22:          resumed_work/4, restart_runtime/2, diagnostics/0,
   23:          operation_diagnostics/2,
   24:          await_node_principal/2, assert_old_key_fenced/2]).
   25: 
   26: -define(NS, <<"agent:failover">>).
   27: -define(ROOT, <<"quod:root">>).
   28: 
   29: all() -> [validator_host_loss_recovers_state, abrupt_host_loss_recovers_state,
   30:           suspended_host_retires_stale_process,
   31:           uncertain_claim_recovers_after_quorum_loss,
   32:           uncertain_claim_recovers_after_target_restart].
   33: 
   34: init_per_testcase(TestCase, Config0) ->
   35:     Config = [{host_loss, TestCase} | Config0],
   36:     put(failover_peers, []),
   37:     try
   38:         Pairs = lists:sort([quod_identity:generate() || _ <- lists:seq(1, 4)]),
   39:         Nodes0 = [start_node(I, Pair, Config)
   40:                   || {I, Pair} <- lists:zip(lists:seq(1, 4), Pairs)],
   41:         learn_peers(Nodes0),
   42:         [_Old0, Administrator0 | _] = Nodes0,
   43:         RootAnchor = start_root(Administrator0, Nodes0),
   44:         Nodes = [start_node_ontology(N) || N <- Nodes0],
   45:         [Old, Administrator | _] = Nodes,
   46:         Observers = tl(Nodes),
   47:         Eligible = lists:sublist(Observers, 2),
   48:         AgentAnchor = start_agent_ontology(Nodes, Observers, Eligible, Administrator),
   49:         install_grants(Observers, Old, AgentAnchor),
   50:         replicate_node_histories(Nodes),
   51:         install_contacts(Nodes, Nodes, RootAnchor, AgentAnchor, Administrator),
   52:         AgentRef = {agent_instance_ref, ?NS, AgentAnchor, actor},
   53:         {ok, Blob} = quod_wire_term:encode_canonical(AgentRef),
   54:         {ok, OldKey} = call(Old, quod_agent_vault, prepare, [Blob, 0]),
   55:         OldRef = maps:get(reference, Old),
   56:         committed(call(Administrator, ?MODULE, submit_node,
   57:             [{node_authorized_goal, ?NS, AgentAnchor,
   58:               {goal, {agent_hosted, actor, OldRef, 1, OldKey}}}])),
   59:         {_InitialBinding, InitialHeight} = call(Old, ?MODULE, await_goal,
   60:             [?NS, {agent_hosted, actor, OldRef, 1, OldKey}, 30000]),
   61:         {OldRuntime, OldChild, _} = call(Old, ?MODULE, await_agent, [AgentRef, 1, 10000]),
   62:         lists:foreach(fun(N) ->
   63:             ok = call(N, quod_ct, await_applied, [?NS, InitialHeight, 30000]),
   64:             ok = call(N, ?MODULE, await_observer, [InitialHeight, 10000]),
   65:             ?assertMatch(#{mode := live, collapses := 0}, call(N, quod_runtime, stats, [?NS]))
   66:         end, Observers),
   67:         [{nodes, Nodes}, {observers, Observers}, {eligible, Eligible},
   68:          {agent_ref, AgentRef}, {root_anchor, RootAnchor}, {old_key, OldKey},
   69:          {old_runtime, OldRuntime}, {old_child, OldChild} | Config]
   70:     catch Class:Reason:Stack ->
   71:         stop_peers(get(failover_peers)),
   72:         erlang:raise(Class, Reason, Stack)
   73:     end.
   74: 
   75: end_per_testcase(_TestCase, Config) ->
   76:     stop_peers([maps:get(peer, N) || N <- ?config(nodes, Config)]),
   77:     ok.
   78: 
   79: %% Keep all transports and hosted children alive. Suspend two of four target
   80: %% consensus owners only AFTER the ordinary signed source claim commits. Proof
   81: %% admission therefore succeeded with quorum; the fault tests delivery custody.
   82: uncertain_claim_recovers_after_quorum_loss(Config) ->
   83:     uncertain_claim_recovers(Config, false).
   84: 
   85: uncertain_claim_recovers_after_target_restart(Config) ->
   86:     uncertain_claim_recovers(Config, true).
   87: 
   88: uncertain_claim_recovers(Config, Restart) ->
   89:     ct:timetrap({minutes, 3}),
   90:     [A, B, C, D] = Nodes = ?config(nodes, Config),
   91:     {agent_instance_ref, ?NS, Anchor, actor} = ?config(agent_ref, Config),
   92:     Goal = {node_authorized_goal, ?NS, Anchor, {record_delivery, durable_delivery}},
   93:     {Prolog, Token, Tx, ClaimRef, OperationRef, Bytes, Signature} =
   94:         call(B, ?MODULE, begin_uncertain_claim, [Goal]),
   95:     SourceNs = maps:get(node_namespace, B),
   96:     ?assertMatch({ok, #{status := claimed}}, call(B, quod_prolog, outcome, [OperationRef])),
   97:     Held = [{N, call(N, quod_reg, where, [{quod_simplex, ?NS}])} || N <- [A, D]],
   98:     try
   99:         lists:foreach(fun({N, Owner}) -> ok = call(N, sys, suspend, [Owner]) end, Held),
  100:         TargetRef = {transaction, ?NS, Anchor, Tx},
  101:         ok = call(B, ?MODULE, release_claim_and_await_expiry, [Prolog, Token, Tx]),
  102:         ?assertMatch({ok, #{status := pending}}, call(B, quod_prolog, outcome, [TargetRef])),
  103:         ?assertMatch({ok, #{operation_state := unresolved}},
  104:                      call(B, quod_prolog, outcome, [OperationRef])),
  105:         %% Fixture caller TTL is shorter than the observed custody deadline.
  106:         ?assertEqual(0, maps:get(parked, call(B, quod_prolog, stats, [?NS]))),
  107:         case Restart of
  108:             true ->
  109:                 %% Drop every target's volatile proposals/relay mailboxes while
  110:                 %% retaining all four ledgers. Otherwise a late old proposal can
  111:                 %% complete even on the broken implementation. Source ontology
  112:                 %% owners and their original committed claim stay running.
  113:                 lists:foreach(fun(N) ->
  114:                     ok = call(N, quod_ns_sup, stop_namespace, [?NS])
  115:                 end, [A, D, B, C]),
  116:                 lists:foreach(fun(N) ->
  117:                     start_namespace(N, ?NS, #{mode => join, genesis_hash => Anchor,
  118:                         seed_peers => [maps:get(endpoint, Other) || Other <- Nodes, Other =/= N]})
  119:                 end, Nodes);
  120:             false ->
  121:                 lists:foreach(fun({N, Owner}) -> ok = call(N, sys, resume, [Owner]) end, Held)
  122:         end,
  123:         %% Only real consensus/application progress may wake the existing
  124:         %% source coordinator. The test never resubmits the signed goal/claim.
  125:         #{operation_state := terminal} =
  126:             call(B, quod_ct, await_operation_complete, [SourceNs, OperationRef, 60000]),
  127:         ?assertMatch({ok, _, {operation_outcome, #{operation_state := terminal},
  128:                              #{status := completed}}},
  129:             call(B, quod_client_goal_ingress, resolve_operation, [Bytes, Signature])),
  130:         {ok, #{status := committed, height := Height}} =
  131:             call(B, quod_prolog, outcome, [TargetRef]),
  132:         lists:foreach(fun(N) ->
  133:             Deadline = quod_time:mono_ms() + 30000,
  134:             ok = call(N, quod_ct, await_applied, [?NS, Height, 30000]),
  135:             {Bindings, ObservedHeight} = call(N, ?MODULE, await_goal,
  136:                 [?NS, {findall, {'X'}, {delivered, {'X'}}, [durable_delivery]},
  137:                  max(0, Deadline - quod_time:mono_ms())]),
  138:             ?assert(is_map(Bindings)),
  139:             ?assert(ObservedHeight >= Height)
  140:         end, Nodes),
  141:         ?assertMatch({ok, #{status := committed}}, call(B, quod_prolog, outcome, [ClaimRef])),
  142:         ct:pal("Original operation completed after custody expiry; restart=~p, target height=~p",
  143:                [Restart, Height])
  144:     catch Class:Reason:Stack ->
  145:         ct:pal("Original claim recovery: ~p", [
  146:             catch call(B, ?MODULE, operation_diagnostics, [SourceNs, OperationRef])]),
  147:         lists:foreach(fun(N) ->
  148:             ct:pal("Node ~p recovery state: ~p", [maps:get(node_namespace, N),
  149:                 catch call(N, ?MODULE, diagnostics, [])])
  150:         end, Nodes),
  151:         erlang:raise(Class, Reason, Stack)
  152:     after
  153:         lists:foreach(fun({N, Owner}) -> catch call(N, sys, resume, [Owner]) end, Held),
  154:         catch call(B, erlang, send, [Prolog, {release_claim, Token}]),
  155:         catch call(B, sys, remove, [Prolog, Token])
  156:     end.
  157: 
  158: begin_uncertain_claim(Goal) ->
  159:     Prolog = quod_reg:where({quod_prolog, ?NS}),
  160:     Token = make_ref(), Parent = self(),
  161:     ok = sys:install(Prolog, {Token, fun ?MODULE:hold_claim_admission/3, {Parent, Token}}),
  162:     {Numbered, _, _} = erlog_int:term_instance(Goal, 0),
  163:     {ok, Bytes, Signature} = quod_node_actor:signed_goal(execute, Numbered,
  164:         crypto:strong_rand_bytes(32), quod_time:now_ms() + 30000),
  165:     spawn(fun() -> Parent ! {claim_submission_result, Token,
  166:                             quod_client_goal_ingress:submit(Bytes, Signature)} end),
  167:     receive
  168:         {claim_held, Token, Tx, ClaimRef, OperationRef} ->
  169:             {Prolog, Token, Tx, ClaimRef, OperationRef, Bytes, Signature};
  170:         {claim_submission_result, Token, Result} ->
  171:             error({submission_ended_before_claim_gate, Result})
  172:     after 15000 -> error(claim_not_admitted)
  173:     end.
  174: 
  175: hold_claim_admission({Parent, Token},
  176:   {in, {'$gen_call', _, {submit_role,
  177:     #transaction{tx_id = Tx, role = {remote_application, ClaimRef, OperationRef, _}}, _, _}}}, _) ->
  178:     Parent ! {claim_held, Token, Tx, ClaimRef, OperationRef},
  179:     receive {release_claim, Token} -> done
  180:     after 15000 -> error(claim_gate_not_released)
  181:     end;
  182: hold_claim_admission(State, _, _) -> State.
  183: 
  184: release_claim_and_await_expiry(Prolog, Token, Tx) ->
  185:     Owner = quod_reg:where({quod_simplex, ?NS}),
  186:     Pattern = {quod_simplex, complete_custody, 3},
  187:     erlang:trace_pattern(Pattern,
  188:         [{['_', {error, not_in_charge, unavailable}, '_'], [], [{return_trace}]}], [local]),
  189:     erlang:trace(Owner, true, [call, {tracer, self()}]),
  190:     try
  191:         Prolog ! {release_claim, Token},
  192:         receive
  193:             {trace, Owner, call, {quod_simplex, complete_custody, [Id, _, State]}} ->
  194:                 [{Id, _, {submit, _, _, Canonical}, _, _, _}] =
  195:                     [Row || Row <- quod_simplex:test_custody(State), element(1, Row) =:= Id],
  196:                 {ok, #{tx_id := Tx}} = quod_transaction:decode_submission_metadata(Canonical)
  197:         after 45000 -> error(custody_did_not_expire_without_quorum)
  198:         end,
  199:         receive {trace, Owner, return_from, Pattern, _} -> ok
  200:         after 1000 -> error(custody_expiry_did_not_complete) end,
  201:         {_, Current} = sys:get_state(Owner),
  202:         ?assertEqual([], quod_simplex:test_custody(Current)),
  203:         ok
  204:     after
  205:         erlang:trace(Owner, false, [call]),
  206:         erlang:trace_pattern(Pattern, false, [local])
  207:     end.
  208: 
  209: abrupt_host_loss_recovers_state(Config) ->
  210:     validator_host_loss_recovers_state(Config).
  211: 
  212: suspended_host_retires_stale_process(Config) ->
  213:     validator_host_loss_recovers_state(Config).
  214: 
  215: validator_host_loss_recovers_state(Config) ->
  216:     ct:timetrap({minutes, 3}),
  217:     try exercise_host_loss(Config)
  218:     catch Class:Reason:Stack ->
  219:         lists:foreach(fun(N) ->
  220:             Snapshot = catch call(N, ?MODULE, diagnostics, []),
  221:             ct:pal("Survivor ~p diagnostics: ~p", [maps:get(node_namespace, N), Snapshot])
  222:         end, tl(?config(nodes, Config))),
  223:         erlang:raise(Class, Reason, Stack)
  224:     end.
  225: 
  226: exercise_host_loss(Config) ->
  227:     [Old | Survivors] = ?config(nodes, Config),
  228:     {agent_instance_ref, ?NS, Anchor, actor} = ?config(agent_ref, Config),
  229:     lists:foreach(fun(N) ->
  230:         ?assertMatch(#{role := validator}, call(N, quod_simplex, status, [?NS]))
  231:     end, [Old | Survivors]),
  232:     lists:foreach(fun(N) ->
  233:         %% These vaults have not prepared or received an agent private key.
  234:         ?assertEqual({ok, []}, call(N, file, list_dir, [maps:get(vault_dir, N)]))
  235:     end, ?config(eligible, Config)),
  236:     [Administrator | _] = Survivors,
  237:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {failed, _}}},
  238:         call(Administrator, ?MODULE, submit_node,
  239:           [{node_authorized_goal, ?NS, Anchor, {assertz, unauthorized_recovery}}])),
  240:     Fault = stop_host(Old, Config),
  241:     ct:pal("Host fault accepted at ~p", [quod_time:mono_ms()]),
  242:     try exercise_recovery(Config, Fault)
  243:     after
  244:         %% Closing the controller's stdin resumes its exact peer on failure.
  245:         case Fault of stopped -> ok; {suspended, P} -> catch port_close(P) end
  246:     end.
  247: 
  248: exercise_recovery(Config, Fault) ->
  249:     [Old | Survivors] = ?config(nodes, Config),
  250:     AgentRef = {agent_instance_ref, ?NS, Anchor, actor} = ?config(agent_ref, Config),
  251:     OldKey = ?config(old_key, Config),
  252:     [Administrator | _] = Survivors,
  253:     {#{'Host' := NewHost, 'Key' := NewKey}, RecoveryHeight} =
  254:         call(Administrator, ?MODULE, await_goal,
  255:              [?NS, {agent_hosted, actor, {'Host'}, 2, {'Key'}}, 90000]),
  256:     ct:pal("Committed epoch 2 at height ~p, time ~p", [RecoveryHeight, quod_time:mono_ms()]),
  257:     [Destination] = [N || N <- ?config(eligible, Config), maps:get(reference, N) =:= NewHost],
  258:     ?assertNotEqual(OldKey, NewKey),
  259:     {Runtime, Child, #{public_key := NewKey}} =
  260:         call(Destination, ?MODULE, await_agent, [AgentRef, 2, 10000]),
  261:     ?assertNotEqual(?config(old_runtime, Config), Runtime),
  262:     ?assertNotEqual(?config(old_child, Config), Child),
  263:     assert_replicated(Survivors, RecoveryHeight, NewHost, NewKey, OldKey, []),
  264:     WorkHeight = call(Destination, ?MODULE, resumed_work,
  265:                       [AgentRef, Runtime, Child, after_recovery]),
  266:     assert_replicated(Survivors, WorkHeight, NewHost, NewKey, OldKey, [after_recovery]),
  267:     {NextRuntime, NextChild, #{public_key := NewKey}} =
  268:         call(Destination, ?MODULE, restart_runtime, [AgentRef, Runtime]),
  269:     ?assertNotEqual(Runtime, NextRuntime),
  270:     ?assertNotEqual(Child, NextChild),
  271:     RestartHeight = call(Destination, ?MODULE, resumed_work,
  272:                          [AgentRef, NextRuntime, NextChild, after_runtime_restart]),
  273:     assert_replicated(Survivors, RestartHeight, NewHost, NewKey, OldKey,
  274:                       [after_recovery, after_runtime_restart]),
  275:     ct:pal("Replacement work committed before host return at ~p", [quod_time:mono_ms()]),
  276:     Returned = case Fault of
  277:         stopped -> boot_node(Old);
  278:         {suspended, Port} ->
  279:             ok = restore_host({suspended, Port}),
  280:             Old
  281:     end,
  282:     try
  283:         case Fault of
  284:             stopped -> resume_host(Returned, Survivors, ?config(root_anchor, Config), Anchor);
  285:             {suspended, _} -> ok
  286:         end,
  287:         assert_replicated([Returned], RestartHeight, NewHost, NewKey, OldKey,
  288:                           [after_recovery, after_runtime_restart]),
  289:         case Fault of
  290:             {suspended, _} ->
  291:                 ok = call(Returned, ?MODULE, await_process_down,
  292:                           [?config(old_child, Config), 10000]);
  293:             stopped -> ok
  294:         end,
  295:         {_, ReturnedChildren} = call(Returned, quod_runtime, agents, [?NS]),
  296:         ?assertEqual([], [B || #{binding := #{reference := R} = B} <- ReturnedChildren,
  297:                               R =:= AgentRef]),
  298:         case Fault of
  299:             {suspended, _} ->
  300:                 %% The same VM and runtime must retire their surviving old child
  301:                 %% when committed state catches up; no test-triggered restart.
  302:                 {ReturnedRuntime, _} = call(Returned, quod_runtime, agents, [?NS]),
  303:                 ?assertEqual(?config(old_runtime, Config), ReturnedRuntime),
  304:                 ?assertNot(call(Returned, erlang, is_process_alive, [?config(old_child, Config)]));
  305:             stopped -> ok
  306:         end,
  307:         ok = call(Returned, ?MODULE, assert_old_key_fenced, [AgentRef, OldKey]),
  308:         FinalHeight = call(Destination, ?MODULE, resumed_work,
  309:                           [AgentRef, NextRuntime, NextChild, after_old_host_return]),
  310:         All = [Returned | Survivors],
  311:         assert_replicated(All, FinalHeight, NewHost, NewKey, OldKey, work_values()),
  312:         lists:foreach(fun(N) ->
  313:             ?assertMatch(#{mode := live, collapses := 0, reconcile_failures := 0},
  314:                          call(N, quod_runtime, stats, [?NS])),
  315:             ?assertMatch(#{role := validator}, call(N, quod_simplex, status, [?NS])),
  316:             {_, Children} = call(N, quod_runtime, agents, [?NS]),
  317:             Hosted = [B || #{binding := #{reference := R} = B} <- Children, R =:= AgentRef],
  318:             Expected = case maps:get(reference, N) =:= NewHost of true -> 1; false -> 0 end,
  319:             ?assertEqual(Expected, length(Hosted))
  320:         end, All)
  321:     after stop_peers([maps:get(peer, Returned)]) end.
  322: 
  323: resume_host(Returned, Survivors = [Administrator | _], RootAnchor, AgentAnchor) ->
  324:     Seeds = [maps:get(endpoint, N) || N <- Survivors],
  325:     resume_namespace(Returned, ?ROOT, RootAnchor, [maps:get(endpoint, Administrator)]),
  326:     learn_peers([Returned | Survivors]),
  327:     %% The persisted pointer restores the own node actor; do not bind it again.
  328:     ok = call(Returned, ?MODULE, await_node_principal,
  329:               [maps:get(reference, Returned), 10000]),
  330:     lists:foreach(fun(N) ->
  331:         resume_namespace(Returned, maps:get(node_namespace, N), maps:get(node_anchor, N),
  332:                          [maps:get(endpoint, N)])
  333:     end, Survivors),
  334:     resume_namespace(Returned, ?NS, AgentAnchor, Seeds),
  335:     {ok, _} = call(Returned, quod_brahms, start_namespace,
  336:                   [?NS, #{node_id => maps:get(endpoint, Returned), seed_peers => Seeds}]),
  337:     install_contacts([Returned], [Returned | Survivors], RootAnchor, AgentAnchor, Administrator).
  338: 
  339: resume_namespace(N, Ns, Anchor, Seeds) ->
  340:     %% Fixture namespaces have no committed hosting intent. Require their old
  341:     %% ledgers explicitly; this must not pass by founding or downloading anew.
  342:     {ok, Resume} = call(N, quod_ontology, prepare_local_resume,
  343:                        [Ns, Anchor, maps:get(data_dir, N)]),
  344:     start_namespace(N, Ns, Resume#{seed_peers => Seeds}),
  345:     ?assertEqual(Anchor, call(N, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [Ns])).
  346: 
  347: assert_replicated(Nodes, Height, Host, Key, OldKey, Work) ->
  348:     Goal = conjunction([
  349:         {findall, {host, {'H'}, {'E'}, {'K'}},
  350:             {agent_host, actor, {'H'}, {'E'}, {'K'}}, [{host, Host, 2, Key}]},
  351:         {findall, {'K'}, {agent_key, actor, {'K'}, active}, [Key]},
  352:         {findall, {'K'}, {agent_key, actor, {'K'}, revoked}, [OldKey]},
  353:         {agent_domain_state, actor, before_loss},
  354:         {findall, {'Value'}, {recovered_work, {'Value'}}, Work},
  355:         {'\\+', unauthorized_recovery},
  356:         {'\\+', {agent_recovery_round, actor, {'_'}, {'_'}, {'_'}}},
  357:         {'\\+', {agent_failure_report, actor, {'_'}, {'_'}, {'_'}, {'_'}, {'_'}, {'_'}}},
  358:         {'\\+', {agent_candidate_key, actor, {'_'}, {'_'}, {'_'}, {'_'}}}]),
  359:     lists:foreach(fun(N) ->
  360:         Deadline = quod_time:mono_ms() + 30000,
  361:         ok = call(N, quod_ct, await_applied, [?NS, Height, 30000]),
  362:         %% Reaching the applied height does not finish the replay handshake.
  363:         %% Observe the existing readiness edge within the same allowance.
  364:         {Bindings, ObservedHeight} = call(N, ?MODULE, await_goal,
  365:             [?NS, Goal, max(0, Deadline - quod_time:mono_ms())]),
  366:         ?assert(is_map(Bindings)),
  367:         ?assert(ObservedHeight >= Height)
  368:     end, Nodes).
  369: 
  370: stop_host(Old, Config) ->
  371:     stop_host(Old, ?config(host_loss, Config), Config).
  372: 
  373: stop_host(#{peer := Peer}, validator_host_loss_recovers_state, _Config) ->
  374:     ok = peer:stop(Peer),
  375:     stopped;
  376: stop_host(#{peer := Peer}, abrupt_host_loss_recovers_state, _Config) ->
  377:     Monitor = monitor(process, Peer),
  378:     %% No application shutdown, output flush, port cleanup or pending I/O drain.
  379:     ok = peer:cast(Peer, erlang, halt, [137, [{flush, false}]]),
  380:     receive
  381:         {'DOWN', Monitor, process, Peer, {exit_status, 137}} -> stopped;
  382:         {'DOWN', Monitor, process, Peer, Reason} -> ct:fail({unexpected_host_exit, Reason})
  383:     after 10000 -> ct:fail(host_did_not_exit)
  384:     end;
  385: stop_host(Old, suspended_host_retires_stale_process, Config) ->
  386:     Python = os:find_executable("python3"),
  387:     Script = filename:join(?config(data_dir, Config), "suspend_peer.py"),
  388:     Pid = call(Old, os, getpid, []),
  389:     Port = open_port({spawn_executable, Python},
  390:                      [{args, [Script, Pid]}, binary, {line, 1024}, exit_status, stderr_to_stdout]),
  391:     try
  392:         ok = fault_reply(Port, <<"stop_accepted">>, quod_time:mono_ms() + 10000, []),
  393:         {suspended, Port}
  394:     catch Class:Reason:Stack ->
  395:         catch port_close(Port),
  396:         erlang:raise(Class, Reason, Stack)
  397:     end.
  398: 
  399: restore_host({suspended, Port}) ->
  400:     true = port_command(Port, <<"resume\n">>),
  401:     try
  402:         ok = fault_reply(Port, <<"resumed">>, quod_time:mono_ms() + 10000, []),
  403:         receive {Port, {exit_status, 0}} -> ok;
  404:                 {Port, Exit} -> error({host_resumption_exit, Exit})
  405:         after 10000 -> error(host_resumption_exit_timeout)
  406:         end
  407:     after catch port_close(Port) end.
  408: 
  409: fault_reply(Port, Expected, Deadline, Lines) ->
  410:     receive
  411:         {Port, {data, {eol, Expected}}} -> ok;
  412:         {Port, {data, {_, Line}}} -> fault_reply(Port, Expected, Deadline, [Line | Lines]);
  413:         {Port, Exit} -> error({fault_controller_failed, Expected, Exit, lists:reverse(Lines)})
  414:     after max(0, Deadline - quod_time:mono_ms()) ->
  415:         error({fault_controller_timeout, Expected, lists:reverse(Lines)})
  416:     end.
  417: 
  418: start_node(Index, Pair = {Pub, _}, Config) ->
  419:     {ok, Socket} = gen_udp:open(0),
  420:     {ok, Port} = inet:port(Socket),
  421:     ok = gen_udp:close(Socket),
  422:     Dir = filename:join([?config(priv_dir, Config), atom_to_list(?config(host_loss, Config)),
  423:                          "peer-" ++ integer_to_list(Index)]),
  424:     Unlock = filename:join(Dir, "vault-unlock"),
  425:     ok = quod_file:write_atomic(Unlock, crypto:strong_rand_bytes(32), 8#600),
  426:     VaultDir = filename:join(Dir, "keys"),
  427:     Name = list_to_atom("agent_failover_" ++ integer_to_list(Port)),
  428:     Identity = #{pubkey => Pub, key => quod_identity:key_term(Pair)},
  429:     N = #{peer_name => Name, public_key => Pub, identity => Identity,
  430:           endpoint => {"127.0.0.1", Port}, data_dir => Dir, vault_dir => VaultDir,
  431:           node_namespace => <<"failover-node-", (integer_to_binary(Index))/binary>>},
  432:     Env = [{listen_port, Port}, {metrics_port, 0}, {node_addr, maps:get(endpoint, N)},
  433:            {node_pubkey, Pub}, {identity_key, maps:get(key, Identity)},
  434:            {identity_cert, quod_identity:mint_cert(Pair)},
  435:            {identity_dir, filename:join(Dir, "identity")}, {content_data_dir, Dir},
  436:            {simplex_delta_ms, 4000}, {effect_journal_data_dir, Dir},
  437:            {foreign_log, #{cache_dir => filename:join(Dir, "foreign-history")}},
  438:            {directory, #{ttl_ms => 600000, expire_tick_ms => 60000}},
  439:            {agent_vault, #{directory => VaultDir, unlock_file => Unlock}}],
  440:     boot_node(N#{boot_env => Env}).
  441: 
  442: boot_node(N0 = #{peer_name := Name, boot_env := Env, data_dir := Dir}) ->
  443:     Ebin = filename:dirname(code:which(quod_simplex)),
  444:     Paths = [Ebin | lists:delete(Ebin, code:get_path())],
  445:     {ok, Peer, _} = peer:start(#{name => Name, connection => standard_io, peer_down => crash,
  446:                                 args => ["+S", "2:2", "-pa" | Paths]}),
  447:     Peers = case get(failover_peers) of undefined -> []; Existing -> Existing end,
  448:     put(failover_peers, [Peer | Peers]),
  449:     N = N0#{peer => Peer},
  450:     try
  451:         true = call(N, os, putenv, ["XDG_CACHE_HOME", filename:join(Dir, "cache")]),
  452:         ok = call(N, logger, set_primary_config, [level, warning]),
  453:         ok = call(N, application, load, [quod]),
  454:         lists:foreach(fun({K, V}) -> ok = call(N, application, set_env, [quod, K, V]) end, Env),
  455:         {ok, _} = call(N, application, ensure_all_started, [quod]),
  456:         {module, ?MODULE} = call(N, code, ensure_loaded, [?MODULE]),
  457:         Ebin = filename:dirname(call(N, code, which, [quod_simplex])),
  458:         N
  459:     catch Class:Reason:Stack ->
  460:         stop_peers([Peer]),
  461:         erlang:raise(Class, Reason, Stack)
  462:     end.

  472: start_root(Founder, Nodes) ->

  476:           external_predicate_modules => [quod_directory_predicates, quod_ontology_predicates]}),
  477:     Anchor = call(Founder, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [?ROOT]),
  478:     lists:foreach(fun(N) ->
  479:         start_namespace(N, ?ROOT, join_config(Founder, Anchor))
  480:     end, Nodes -- [Founder]),

  484: start_node_ontology(N = #{node_namespace := Ns, public_key := Pub}) ->
  485:     {ok, Execution} = erlog_io:read_file(filename:join(code:priv_dir(quod),
  486:                                                      "ontologies/node_instance.pl")),
  487:     Principal = {agent_instance_ref, Ns, {'_'}, physical_node},
  488:     SigningPrincipal = {agent_instance_ref, Ns, {'NodeAnchor'}, physical_node},
  489:     SigningRead = {'::', ?NS,
  490:         {',', {agent_hosted, actor, SigningPrincipal, {'Epoch'}, {'Key'}},
  491:          {sign_agent_request, {'Request'}, {'Signature'}}}},
  492:     Terms = Execution ++ [
  493:         {instance_of, node, physical_node}, {agent_key, physical_node, Pub, active},
  494:         {can_invoke, {node_authorized_goal, ?NS, {'_'}, {'_'}}, Principal, {'_'}, Ns},
  495:         {can_invoke, {assertz, {can_execute_for, ?NS, {'_'}, {'_'}}}, Principal, {'_'}, Ns},
  496:         {can_invoke, SigningRead, SigningPrincipal, {'_'}, Ns}],
  497:     start_namespace(N, Ns, #{mode => create, genesis_diff => quod_prolog:terms_to_diff(Terms)}),
  498:     ok = call(N, quod_ct, await_applied, [Ns, 1, 10000]),
  499:     Anchor = call(N, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [Ns]),
  500:     {ok, PrincipalValue} = call(N, ?MODULE, bind_node, [Ns, Anchor]),
  501:     Ref = {agent_instance_ref, Ns, Anchor, physical_node},
  502:     {ok, PrincipalValue} = call(N, quod_node_actor, principal, []),
  503:     N#{reference => Ref, node_anchor => Anchor}.

  505: start_agent_ontology([Founder | Others], Observers, Eligible, Administrator) ->
  506:     {ok, Instance} = erlog_io:read_file(filename:join(code:priv_dir(quod),
  507:                                                     "ontologies/agent_instance.pl")),
  508:     {ok, Recovery} = erlog_io:read_file(filename:join(code:priv_dir(quod),
  509:                                                     "ontologies/agent_recovery_policy.pl")),
  510:     Terms = Instance ++ Recovery ++ agent_policy(Founder, Observers, Eligible, Administrator),
  511:     Committee = [{maps:get(public_key, N), Host, Port}
  512:                  || N <- Others, {Host, Port} <- [maps:get(endpoint, N)]],
  513:     start_namespace(Founder, ?NS,
  514:         #{mode => create, committee => Committee,
  515:           genesis_diff => quod_prolog:terms_to_diff(Terms),
  516:           external_predicate_modules => [quod_agent_predicates]}),
  517:     Anchor = call(Founder, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [?NS]),
  518:     lists:foreach(fun(N) -> start_namespace(N, ?NS, join_config(Founder, Anchor)) end, Others),
  519:     lists:foreach(fun(N) ->
  520:         ok = call(N, quod_ct, await_applied, [?NS, 1, 30000]),
  521:         {ok, _} = call(N, quod_brahms, start_namespace,
  522:           [?NS, #{node_id => maps:get(endpoint, N), seed_peers => [maps:get(endpoint, Founder)]}])
  523:     end, [Founder | Others]),
  524:     Anchor.

  526: agent_policy(Old, Observers, Eligible, Administrator) ->
  527:     OldRef = maps:get(reference, Old), AdminRef = maps:get(reference, Administrator),
  528:     Goal = {'Goal'}, Principal = {'Principal'}, Value = {'Value'},
  529:     Guarded = {',', {current_ontology_identity, ?NS, {'_'}}, {call, Goal}},
  530:     Signing = {',', {agent_hosted, actor, Principal, {'Epoch'}, {'Key'}},
  531:                {sign_agent_request, {'Request'}, {'Signature'}}},
  532:     ObservationRights = [{agent_recovery_observer, actor, maps:get(reference, N)} || N <- Observers],
  533:     Placement = lists:append([[{eligible_agent_host, actor, maps:get(reference, N)},
  534:                               {agent_host_rank, actor, maps:get(reference, N), Rank}]
  535:                              || {N, Rank} <- lists:zip(Eligible, [1, 2])]),
  536:     SigningRights = [begin
  537:         {ok, Text} = quod_client_goal_parser:format_clause({record_recovered_work, V}),
  538:         Request = {agent_goal_v1, {'_'}, {agent_instance_ref, ?NS, {'_'}, actor},
  539:                    {'_'}, {'_'}, {'_'}, {'_'}, execute, 3, Text},
  540:         {':-', {can_request_agent_signature, Principal, actor, Request},
  541:          {eligible_agent_host, actor, Principal}}
  542:     end || V <- work_values()],
  543:     ObservationRights ++ Placement ++ SigningRights ++ [
  544:         {agent_recovery_threshold, actor, 2}, {agent_domain_state, actor, before_loss},
  545:         {can_assign_agent_host, AdminRef, actor, none, 0, OldRef, {'_'}},
  546:         {':-', {can_invoke, Guarded, Principal, {'_'}, ?NS},
  547:          {',', {agent_recovery_observer, actor, Principal}, {failover_entry, Goal}}},
  548:         {failover_entry, {report_agent_observation, actor, OldRef, 1,
  549:                           {'_'}, {'_'}, {'_'}, {'_'}}},
  550:         {failover_entry, {report_agent_observation_with_custody, actor, OldRef, 1,
  551:                           {'_'}, {'_'}, {'_'}, {'_'}, {'_'}}},
  552:         {failover_entry, {goal, {agent_hosted, actor, OldRef, 1, {'_'}}}},
  553:         {failover_entry, {trigger_event, {resume_work, Value}}},
  554:         {failover_entry, {record_delivery, durable_delivery}},
  555:         {':-', {record_delivery, Value}, {assertz, {delivered, Value}}},
  556:         {':-', {can_invoke, Signing, Principal, {'_'}, ?NS},
  557:          {agent_hosted, actor, Principal, {'Epoch'}, {'Key'}}},
  558:         {':-', {can_invoke, {record_recovered_work, Value},
  559:                  {agent_instance_ref, ?NS, {'Anchor'}, actor}, {'_'}, ?NS},
  560:          {current_ontology_identity, ?NS, {'Anchor'}}},
  561:         {':-', {react_on, {resume_work, Value}, {record_recovered_work, Value}},
  562:          {me, {agent_instance_ref, ?NS, {'_'}, actor}}},
  563:         {':-', {record_recovered_work, Value}, conjunction([
  564:             {agent_domain_state, actor, before_loss},
  565:             {'\\+', {recovered_work, Value}}, {assertz, {recovered_work, Value}}])}].

  567: install_grants(Observers, Old, Anchor) ->
  568:     OldRef = maps:get(reference, Old),
  569:     [Administrator | _] = Observers,
  570:     lists:foreach(fun(N) ->
  571:         Reports = [{report_agent_observation, actor, OldRef, 1, {'_'}, {'_'}, {'_'}, {'_'}},
  572:                    {report_agent_observation_with_custody, actor, OldRef, 1,
  573:                     {'_'}, {'_'}, {'_'}, {'_'}, {'_'}}],
  574:         Initial = case N =:= Administrator of
  575:             true -> [{goal, {agent_hosted, actor, OldRef, 1, {'_'}}}]; false -> []
  576:         end,
  577:         Work = [{record_delivery, durable_delivery} |
  578:                 [{trigger_event, {resume_work, V}} || V <- work_values()]],
  579:         lists:foreach(fun(G) ->
  580:             committed(call(N, ?MODULE, submit_node,
  581:                            [{assertz, {can_execute_for, ?NS, Anchor, G}}]))
  582:         end, Reports ++ Initial ++ Work)
  583:     end, Observers).

  595: install_contacts(Recipients, Advertisers, RootAnchor, AgentAnchor, RootFounder) ->

  603:                        validator, node}],

  607:                    page => 0, last => true, hosted => lists:sort(Hosted)}])

  611: start_namespace(N, Ns, Extra) ->

  613:                          data_dir => maps:get(data_dir, N)}, Extra),

  617: join_config(Source, Anchor) ->
  618:     #{mode => join, genesis_hash => Anchor, seed_peers => [maps:get(endpoint, Source)]}.
  619: 
  620: %% The following helpers run on a peer through its stdio control connection.
  621: %% Every wait subscribes before its snapshot and advances only on owner events.
  622: bind_node(Ns, Anchor) ->
  623:     true = quod_reg:subscribe({node_actor, node}),
  624:     try
  625:         {ok, Principal} = quod_node_actor:bind(Ns, Anchor, <<"physical_node.">>, 2),
  626:         await_principal(Principal, quod_time:mono_ms() + 10000),
  627:         {ok, Principal}
  628:     after quod_reg:unsubscribe({node_actor, node}) end.
  629: 
  630: await_node_principal(Ref, Timeout) ->
  631:     {ok, Blob} = quod_wire_term:encode_canonical(Ref),
  632:     true = quod_reg:subscribe({node_actor, node}),
  633:     try await_principal({agent, Blob}, quod_time:mono_ms() + Timeout)
  634:     after quod_reg:unsubscribe({node_actor, node}) end.
  635: 
  636: await_principal(Principal, Deadline) ->
  637:     case quod_node_actor:principal() of
  638:         {ok, Principal} -> ok;
  639:         _ -> receive
  640:             {node_actor_installed, _, _} -> await_principal(Principal, Deadline)
  641:         after max(0, Deadline - quod_time:mono_ms()) -> error(node_principal_not_installed)
  642:         end
  643:     end.
  644: 
  645: submit_node(Goal) ->
  646:     {Numbered, _, _} = erlog_int:term_instance(Goal, 0),
  647:     {ok, Bytes, Signature} = quod_node_actor:signed_goal(execute, Numbered,
  648:         crypto:strong_rand_bytes(32), quod_time:now_ms() + 30000),
  649:     case quod_client_goal_ingress:submit(Bytes, Signature) of
  650:         {ok, _, {normalized, {pending, {operation, Ns, _, _, _} = Ref}}} ->
  651:             logger:warning("Pending operation evidence: ~p", [operation_diagnostics(Ns, Ref)]),
  652:             %% Observe this exact request's durable completion. Its signed
  653:             %% expiry is unchanged; neither this helper nor the runtime submits
  654:             %% it again or creates a replacement operation.
  655:             try quod_ct:await_operation_complete(Ns, Ref, 30000)
  656:             catch Class:Reason:Stack ->
  657:                 logger:warning("Unresolved operation evidence: ~p", [operation_diagnostics(Ns, Ref)]),
  658:                 erlang:raise(Class, Reason, Stack)
  659:             end,
  660:             quod_client_goal_ingress:resolve_operation(Bytes, Signature);
  661:         Result -> Result
  662:     end.
  663: 
  664: diagnostics() ->
  665:     [#{namespace => Ns, proof => quod_prolog:stats(Ns),
  666:        consensus => quod_simplex:stats(Ns), runtime => quod_runtime:stats(Ns),
  667:        status => maps:with([role, committed, approved, last_applied, recovery,
  668:                             progress_phase, progress_quorum_ready, proposal_open],
  669:                            quod_simplex:status(Ns)),
  670:        progress => progress_diagnostics(Ns)}
  671:      || Ns <- quod_prolog:namespaces()].
  672: 
  673: operation_diagnostics(Ns, Ref) ->
  674:     {_, State} = sys:get_state(quod_reg:where({quod_simplex, Ns})),
  675:     Recovery = maps:get(Ref, quod_simplex:test_operation_recoveries(State), #{}),
  676:     Targets = maps:get(target_ref, Recovery, []),
  677:     #{outcome => quod_prolog:local_outcome(Ns, Ref),
  678:       recovery => maps:with([claim_state, status, slot, target_ref, results], Recovery),
  679:       worker => case maps:get(pid, Recovery, undefined) of
  680:           Pid when is_pid(Pid) -> process_info(Pid,
  681:               [current_function, current_stacktrace, message_queue_len]);
  682:           _ -> none
  683:       end,
  684:       targets => [{T, quod_prolog:local_outcome(element(2, T), T)} || T <- Targets]}.
  685: 
  686: progress_diagnostics(Ns) ->
  687:     {_, State} = sys:get_state(quod_reg:where({quod_simplex, Ns})),
  688:     #{head => quod_simplex:test_progress(State),
  689:       position => quod_simplex:test_protocol_position(State),
  690:       pools => quod_simplex:test_engine_pool_sizes(State)}.
  691: 
  692: await_goal(Ns, Goal, Timeout) ->
  693:     true = quod_reg:subscribe({runtime, Ns}),
  694:     Owner = quod_reg:where({quod_prolog, Ns}),
  695:     Monitor = monitor(process, Owner),
  696:     try await_goal_read(Ns, Owner, Monitor, Goal, quod_time:mono_ms() + Timeout)
  697:     after demonitor(Monitor, [flush]), quod_reg:unsubscribe({runtime, Ns}) end.
  698: 
  699: await_goal_read(Ns, Owner, Monitor, Goal, Deadline) ->
  700:     case quod_prolog:prove_ro(Ns, Goal) of
  701:         {ok, [Bindings], Height} -> {Bindings, Height};
  702:         {fail, _} -> await_goal_edge(Ns, Owner, Monitor, Goal, Deadline);
  703:         {error, rebuilding} -> await_goal_edge(Ns, Owner, Monitor, Goal, Deadline);
  704:         Other -> error({unexpected_goal_result, Ns, Goal, Other})
  705:     end.
  706: 
  707: await_goal_edge(Ns, Owner, Monitor, Goal, Deadline) ->
  708:     receive
  709:         {projection_advanced, Owner, _} -> await_goal_read(Ns, Owner, Monitor, Goal, Deadline);
  710:         {replay_ready, _, _} -> await_goal_read(Ns, Owner, Monitor, Goal, Deadline);
  711:         {'DOWN', Monitor, process, Owner, Why} -> error({proof_owner_down, Why})
  712:     after max(0, Deadline - quod_time:mono_ms()) ->
  713:         error({goal_not_reached, Goal, quod_runtime:stats(Ns), quod_simplex:stats(Ns)})
  714:     end.
  715: 
  716: await_agent(Ref = {agent_instance_ref, Ns, _, _}, Epoch, Timeout) ->
  717:     true = quod_reg:subscribe({agent_hosting, Ns}),
  718:     try
  719:         {Owner, Children} = quod_runtime:agents(Ns),
  720:         case [{Owner, Pid, B} || #{pid := Pid, binding := #{reference := R, epoch := E} = B}
  721:                                    <- Children, R =:= Ref, E =:= Epoch] of
  722:             [Installed] -> Installed;
  723:             [] -> receive
  724:                 {agent_installed, Owner, Child, #{reference := Ref, epoch := Epoch} = B, _} ->
  725:                     {Owner, Child, B}
  726:             after Timeout -> error({agent_not_installed, Ref, Epoch, quod_runtime:stats(Ns)}) end
  727:         end
  728:     after quod_reg:unsubscribe({agent_hosting, Ns}) end.
  729: 
  730: %% Subscribe before the installed-state snapshot. The real observer owner
  731: %% publishes after changing its watch set; no handler revision is fabricated.
  732: await_observer(Height, Timeout) ->
  733:     true = quod_reg:subscribe({agent_hosting, ?NS}),
  734:     try
  735:         Owner = quod_reg:where({quod_runtime, ?NS}),
  736:         case gen_server:call(Owner, get_stats) of
  737:             #{observed_agent_instances := 1, e_frontier := H} when H >= Height -> ok;
  738:             _ -> receive
  739:                 {agent_observation_installed, Owner,
  740:                  #{observed_agent_instances := 1}, H} when H >= Height -> ok
  741:             after Timeout -> error({observation_not_installed, quod_runtime:stats(?NS)}) end
  742:         end
  743:     after quod_reg:unsubscribe({agent_hosting, ?NS}) end.
  744: 
  745: await_process_down(Pid, Timeout) ->
  746:     Monitor = monitor(process, Pid),
  747:     try receive {'DOWN', Monitor, process, Pid, _} -> ok
  748:         after Timeout -> error({stale_agent_survived, Pid}) end
  749:     after demonitor(Monitor, [flush]) end.
  750: 
  751: resumed_work(Ref = {agent_instance_ref, Ns, Anchor, _}, Runtime, Child, Value) ->
  752:     true = quod_reg:subscribe({agent, Ref}),
  753:     try
  754:         committed(submit_node({node_authorized_goal, Ns, Anchor,
  755:                                {trigger_event, {resume_work, Value}}})),
  756:         receive
  757:             {agent_request_finished, Runtime, Child, #{reference := Ref}, _, Result} ->
  758:                 committed(Result)
  759:         after 20000 -> error({resumed_work_not_completed, Value, quod_runtime:stats(Ns)}) end,
  760:         {#{}, Height} = await_goal(Ns, {recovered_work, Value}, 10000),
  761:         Height
  762:     after quod_reg:unsubscribe({agent, Ref}) end.
  763: 
  764: restart_runtime(Ref = {agent_instance_ref, Ns, _, _}, Runtime) ->
  765:     Sup = quod_reg:where({quod_ns, Ns}),
  766:     ok = supervisor:terminate_child(Sup, quod_runtime),
  767:     false = is_process_alive(Runtime),
  768:     {ok, _} = supervisor:restart_child(Sup, quod_runtime),
  769:     await_agent(Ref, 2, 10000).
  770: 
  771: assert_old_key_fenced(Ref = {agent_instance_ref, Ns, Anchor, actor}, OldKey) ->
  772:     {ok, Network} = quod_ontology:network_identity(),
  773:     Expires = quod_time:now_ms() + 30000,
  774:     Request = #{network_identity => Network, agent_namespace => Ns,
  775:       agent_genesis_anchor => Anchor, agent_instance_text => <<"actor.">>,
  776:       signing_public_key => OldKey, operation_id => crypto:strong_rand_bytes(32),
  777:       not_after_ms => Expires, mode => execute, parser_version => 2,
  778:       goal_text => <<"record_recovered_work(stale_old_host).">>},
  779:     %% Direct custody signing is the adversarial fixture: the retained key is
  780:     %% usable, but ordinary ingress must reject its revoked authority.
  781:     {ok, Bytes, Signature} = quod_agent_vault:sign(Request, quod_time:mono_ms() + 5000),
  782:     {ok, Blob} = quod_wire_term:encode_canonical(Ref),
  783:     ?assertMatch({ok, #{agent_ref_blob := Blob}}, quod_client_goal:verify(Bytes, Signature)),
  784:     ?assert(quod_time:now_ms() < Expires),
  785:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {failed, _}}},
  786:                  quod_client_goal_ingress:submit(Bytes, Signature)),
  787:     ?assert(quod_time:now_ms() < Expires),
  788:     ?assertMatch({fail, _}, quod_prolog:prove_ro(Ns, {recovered_work, stale_old_host})),
  789:     ok.
  790: 
  791: work_values() -> [after_recovery, after_runtime_restart, after_old_host_return].
  792: 
  793: committed({ok, _, {operation_outcome, _, #{status := completed, targets := Rows}}}) ->
  794:     ?assert(Rows =/= []),
  795:     lists:foreach(fun(Row) -> ?assertMatch({_, {committed, _}}, Row) end, Rows),
  796:     ok;
  797: committed(Result) ->
  798:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {committed, [_], _}}}, Result),
  799:     ok.
  800: 
  801: conjunction([G]) -> G;
  802: conjunction([G | Rest]) -> {',', G, conjunction(Rest)}.
  803: 
  804: call(#{peer := Peer}, Module, Function, Args) ->
  805:     peer:call(Peer, Module, Function, Args, 120000).
  806: 
  807: stop_peers(Peers) -> lists:foreach(fun(Peer) -> catch peer:stop(Peer) end, Peers).
